text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —It has come to an end, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay! Controlling the claw on this 
type of machine is really tricky...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If the difficulty seems too high, I'll 
find a good opportunity to mention it to 
the company.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
